title: Territory boundary router: tenant-scoped exceptions and allow/deny policy adapter
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a Territory Boundary Router component that evaluates tenant-scoped geo compliance policies and enforces region/tier routing decisions. The adapter must: (1) evaluate allowlists/denylists and tenant opt-in/opt-out exceptions, (2) integrate with the policy decision service (PDS) to return deterministic decisions with precedence rules, (3) emit audit events for each decision, and (4) support controlled failover to approved non-resident model variants only when tenant policy permits. This ticket covers schema design, runtime integration, tests, observability hooks, and a phased rollout plan behind a feature flag.
acceptance_criteria: Policy schema defined and documented (allowlist, denylist, tenant_exceptions, fallback_policy) with precedence rules
Router integrated into request path and returns routing metadata (region, model_variant, reason_code) for downstream runtime
Deny decisions block non-compliant routing and surface a clear error to caller with user-facing error code mapping
Allowlist or tenant_exemption can permit cross-border routing only if fallback_policy explicitly allows and audit flag is set
Audit log events emitted to observability pipeline with fields: tenant_id, decision, matched_rule_id, request_id, timestamp
E2E tests covering: tenant in EU-only mode, tenant with explicit allowlist entry, tenant blocking, and fallback-to-compatible-variant flows
Performance regression <= 3ms p50 added latency for decision evaluation at 99th percentile load
Feature rollout plan exists: feature-flag gating, canary on 5% of traffic, telemetry dashboard with decision breakdown
tasks: Design: finalize policy JSON schema and precedence doc (Confluence draft)
Backend: implement Territory Boundary Router service and policy evaluation client
Runtime: surface routing metadata in request context for kernel scheduler and model selector
Console: add tenant-level toggle and a read-only policy viewer in admin UI
Observability: emit decision audit events and add Grafana panels for decision distribution
Tests: unit + integration + e2e harness with simulated multi-region backends
Docs: public SDK error mapping and migration guide for customers with residency requirements
Rollout: coordinated canary, SRE runbook for rollback, post-rollout audit checklist
